reply.text:
Sorry to hear the back's giving you trouble. Pain or soreness in your back is one for a doctor or physio to look at, not me, so I won't guess at what's going on or how to work around it.

Skipping deadlifts today is a sensible call while you get it checked. If you tell me what the session is, I can help you plan the rest of the training around that, and I'll pull up your program if you want to see what's on the schedule.
